note: Tennessee State Park in the woods south of Henderson. The RV campground's sites are paved, with picnic tables and grills, beside a playground. The park also has a tent campground near the lake and a wrangler campground for campers with horses. --Claude
summary: Chickasaw SP: 52 reservable RV sites (2-53), all full hookups 20/30/50 A (the old note's '~26 with sewer' is out of date), paved, 55-120 ft, 11 pull-throughs; $40 every sampled night Nov 2026-Oct 2027 (stored $40-50 left); year-round; not waterfront kept; phone 731-989-8339 -> 731-989-5141; pin likely ~700 m off (tentative).
flags: PHONE 731-989-8339 -> 731-989-5141 (park page 'Phone number 1-731-989-5141'; the reservation engine's site contact '(731) 989-5141').

PIN (tentative): stored 35.39434,-88.77159 sits on Hwy 100 beside a small facility north of the road; the engine's RV Campground map puts the loops north of 'Campground Road', which OSM draws from 35.3902,-88.7735 west to -88.7826 and north to 35.3923. Imagery around 35.3912,-88.7790 shows pads under canopy between Hwy 100 and that road. Suggested 35.3912,-88.7790 (~700 m SW of the pin) - could not be confirmed under canopy; worth a look before moving.

FEES left as stored ($40-50, read 2026-10-12): every RV night sampled across eight two-week windows (Nov 2026-Oct 2027) was $40; the $50 seen in October 2026 did not recur. nightly_high could drop to 40 if the reviewer prefers.

SITES: count 53 -> 52 (sites 2-53 reservable; site 1 is grey/unreservable on the site map, probably a host). max_rig 60 -> 94 (park page 'up to 94 feet'; engine park lengths run to 120 ft, with sites 44/45 showing evident typos '875'/'625').
HORSE: Wrangler sites 57-85 'only intended for guests camping with horses'; 54-56 carry no such line. The entry is the RV campground, which is general - no flag.
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the RV campground is inland; only the tent-only campground has lake views.
TENT AREA sites 86-114 list 20/30 A electric and 22-42 ft pads at $28, but the park page calls the tent campground 'Tent Only'; not used for the low rate.
